needs.what: a per-player turn ledger of energy counters paid or otherwise lost this turn (e.g. {"energy_paid_or_lost_this_turn": "you"}), usable as a card-level cost_reduction amount so the spell costs {1} less per energy counter
needs.why_existing_wont_do: cost_reduction takes only amount (a flat number gated by a condition), count, greatest_count, greatest_mana_value, total_mana_value or total_power, all of which read permanents; value_keys has turn ledgers for life gained/lost, cards drawn/discarded and counters put, but nothing that records energy counters paid or lost, and counters_on reads objects rather than a player's energy tally
